description: This PHP class 'FormatWithLanguage' implements the 'ValueFormatter' interface and provides a method to format a value by retrieving the language name associated with an ID, using the 'LanguageService'. It is part of the OrangeHRM system, specifically in the maintenance access strategy for formatting values with language information.

classes.name: FormatWithLanguage
classes.description: A class that formats a language ID value into the corresponding language name by utilizing the LanguageService.

methods.name: getFormattedValue
methods.description: Retrieves the language name for the given language ID entity value.

methods.name: getLanguageService
methods.description: Lazy-initializes and returns an instance of LanguageService.
